authenticity.evidence: 1,513 unique buyers against 128 unique sellers and about 1,550 holders within 12 minutes suggests broad retail participation. But GMGN tags 96 bundler wallets (top bundler share about 7%). The coin has no socials beyond a link to one X status, no paid boosts, and no smart-money or KOL wallets. More than 10 same-name clones launched within minutes, which is typical of a deployer race chasing one viral tweet.
authenticity.uncertainty: Without X data I cannot tell whether the linked tweet (CookedSupermann) is truly viral, or which contract the community treats as the real one.

structured_output.counterargument: This contract has the most liquidity and the widest buyer base among the clones, and the per-holder concentration is low (GMGN top10 holds 2.2%). If the tweet keeps spreading, volume could settle on the leading contract, and a coin under $100k could double quickly. It already went from launch to a $169k all-time high in minutes.

structural_risks: RugCheck flags 99.99% of LP as unlocked, which conflicts with GMGN's lp_burn_ratio of 1.0
The creator has already sold or closed their position (creator_close)
The coin is already about 42% below its $169k all-time high, reached minutes after launch
Liquidity is only about $29k and is split across more than 10 clone pools
The platform data conflict (meteora_virtual_curve vs pumpswap) raises doubt about the LP structure

narrative.description: 'Memetically-Engineered Product' (m/ep) looks like a tweet-derived meme (from the CookedSupermann status link). Deployers quickly launched many same-name coins on it.
narrative.why_spreading: A tweet phrase went viral enough to set off a clone race. Early buyers are spread across several contracts.

source_coverage.notes: No internet access in this condition. The analysis uses only the evidence packet.

structured_output.thesis: This is one of more than 10 same-name clones of a tweet meme and not the first: the pump.fun contract 6mEf... launched about 4 minutes earlier and has more h1 volume. It has brief leadership on liquidity and buyer count. However, it is already about 42% off its all-time high, the creator has exited, and bundlers are present. Clone races usually split attention and fade, so a +100% move before -50% is below average for this pool.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has the same name and ticker as the tweet meme, the highest mcap and liquidity among the clones, and 1,500 unique buyers.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are more than 10 same-name tokens. The main one is 6mEf...pump (earlier launch, $263k h1 volume, $57k mcap, $20k liquidity). 9Bro... has $27k liquidity. The rest are mostly dead.

unknowns: Whether the source tweet is truly viral and who posted it
Which contract the community or the tweet author endorses
Whether the LP is actually locked or burned, since RugCheck and GMGN disagree

structured_output.what_is_happening: A 12-minute-old m/ep token, apparently launched through a Meteora virtual curve and now migrated, spiked to a $169k all-time high on a burst of 1,500 buyers. It has since pulled back to about $98k. It is competing with many same-name clones born from the same tweet.
